Author: Krishan Pahal

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:238975
Court No. - 72
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 13247 of 2023
Applicant :- Manoja Devi

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Vinod Kumar Ojha,Bharat Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.
2. Supplementary affidavit filed by learned counsel for the applicant is taken on record.

3. Heard Sri Vinod Kumar Ojha, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Amit Kumar, learned A.G.A. for the State as well as perused the record.
4.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Case Crime No. 420 of 2023, registered under Sections 363, 366 I.P.C. at Police Station- Jhunsi, District- Prayagraj with a prayer to enlarge her on anticipatory bail.
5. As per prosecution story, the co-accused person Manish is stated to have enticed away the minor daughter of the informant on 30.9.2023 at about 7:30 a.m. when she had gone to attend her school.

It is mentioned in the FIR that the applicant and other accused persons were implicated in the said Manoja Devi vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145683720/
1 offence committed by the co-accused person Manish being their relatives.
6.

entities.text: Manoja Devi vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that she has been falsely implicated in this case.
The applicant is a lady and has nothing to do with the said offence.
The criminal history of one case assigned to the applicant stands explained as the said offence is bailable.
Learned counsel has stated that the main accused person is Manish.
The applicant has simply been made an accused as she is the maternal aunt of the accused person Manish and it is stated that he used to live in the house of the applicant.
The applicant is a widow lady and there is nobody to look after the family.
7. Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against her.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
The applicant has apprehension of her arrest.

Learned counsel has stated that the applicant undertakes that she has co-operated in the investigation and is ready to do so in trial also failing which the State can move appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail.
8. Per contra, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the anticipatory bail application but unable to dispute the submissions raised by the learned counsel for the applicant.

9. On due consideration to the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and considering the nature of accusations and antecedents of the applicant, the applicant is liable to be enlarged on anticipatory bail in view of the judgment of Supreme Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1".

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The future contingencies regarding the anticipatory bail being granted to applicant shall also be taken care of as per the aforesaid judgment of the Apex Court.
10. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.

entities.text: Manoja Devi vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 11. It is made clear that observations made hereinabove are exclusively for deciding the instant anticipatory bail application and shall not affect the trial.

Order Date :- 16.12.2023/Vikas [Krishan Pahal, J.]
